sn48.60:1.1: Tatravoca || || Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni anuppannāni uppajjanti naññatra sugatavinayā || || Katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ. samādhindriyam paññindriyam || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni anuppannāni uppajjanti nāññatra sugatavinayā ti || || Vaggo chaṭṭho || ||
sn48.60:2.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Sālam Mallikaṃ Sekho ca || Pade Sāre Patiṭṭhito || Brahma Sūkarakhatāya || Uppāde apare duve ti || ||
